mechanism: Carbamazepine is a potent CYP450 inducer that increases metabolism of isocarboxazid, reducing its MAOI efficacy, while concurrent use increases risk of serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and severe CNS toxicity.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if MAOI therapy is necessary, select an alternative anticonvulsant without enzyme-inducing properties or use non-MAOI antidepressants.
